_doc: 3D shoes for the try-on model. 'products' is keyed by product slug (lib/catalog.js) and may map colourway slugs to their own files. Only add a product here when a real 3D scan/model of THAT product exists. 'studio' holds the generic placeholder shoes, which are not YOLO products and are labelled as such on the site. Every model: a RIGHT shoe, toe towards +z, heel at z = 0, sole at y = 0, real-world metres. length_mm = outside length of the model as built, size_eu = the size it represents. sole_mm = height of the insole under the heel (how far the shoe lifts the wearer). collar_mm = lowest height of the collar/topline above the sole bottom (anything of the foot below it is hidden).
